from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or reference name of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., '判决书', '裁定书')")
    identified_causes: list[str] = Field(description="List of specific crimes, causes of action, or penalties found in the text")
    broad_legal_category: str | None = Field(description="Broad classification (e.g., 'Criminal', 'Civil', 'Administrative')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
